subject: Request for SOC 2 Type II bridge letter to cover post-audit gap
messages:
From: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@pexarol.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@pexarol.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 coverage — post-report bridge letter request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the SOC 2 packet you shared last week. Our security team has reviewed Redwood's SOC 2 Type II (report period 2023-01-01 to 2023-12-31) but flagged a coverage gap between the report end date and our contract effective date. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a bridge letter from your audit firm that attests there were no material control changes since the report's end date through today, or at minimum through our contract effective date (2026-04-15)?

If a firm-issued bridge letter is not available, would Redwood provide an internal attestation and an accompanying timeline for when an updated SOC 2 or a complementary attestation can be expected? We need this to close our procurement controls checklist.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement is targeting sign-off next week.

Best,
Sara Bennett
Senior InfoSec Manager, Pexarol
Sara.Bennett@pexarol.com
Attachment: Pexarol_Security_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@pexarol.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 coverage — post-report bridge letter request

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and for reviewing the report. Short answers up front: we can request a bridge letter from Brightstone (our auditor) and we can also provide a Redwood attestation as an interim step.

A couple of clarifying items so we pull exactly what you need:
- Is Pexarol OK with a bridge letter that covers up to 2026-04-15 (your stated contract effective date), or do you need "through today" wording?
- Do you require the bridge letter to be signed by Brightstone on firm letterhead, or would a signed email from the engagement partner suffice for your procurement docs?

Dev (cc'd) — can you open a formal request with Brightstone and attach our current SOC 2 PDF? Marissa, marking for visibility if you want to engage Brightstone directly.

We aim to get a response from Brightstone within 48 business hours; if that won't satisfy Pexarol's timeline we'll escalate.

Thanks,
Soojin
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123
Attachment: none

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Brightstone Audit <audits@brightstone-audit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 14:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request for bridge letter — Pexarol (attached: SOC 2 report)

Hi Brightstone team,

Forwarding a request from a prospective customer (Pexarol) asking for a bridge letter that covers the period from the SOC 2 report end date (2023-12-31) through 2026-04-15. Please see the inbound message below.

We have attached Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20230101-20231231.pdf and our original engagement letter for context. Can you confirm:
1) Whether Brightstone will issue a short bridge letter on firm letterhead attesting no material changes in controls up to 2026-04-15;
2) Typical turnaround and any fees incurred; and
3) Any standard disclaimer language you include so we can ensure Pexarol is comfortable with it.

If you need an internal attestation first, let us know and we'll produce that immediately.

Thank you — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Dev Patel
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20230101-20231231.pdf (report stub); audit-engagement-letter-20251201.pdf (engagement stub)

From: Brightstone Audit <audits@brightstone-audit.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@pexarol.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request for bridge letter — Pexarol (Redwood Inference)

Hi Dev and team,

Thanks for the request and for attaching the SOC 2 report. Brightstone can provide a limited-scope bridge letter on firm letterhead that: (a) confirms no material changes to the control environment have been identified since the report period end (2023-12-31) through a specified coverage date, and (b) references the existing SOC 2 Type II report.

Please note the following standard points:
- We require an engagement confirmation and a signed subject authorization from Redwood to issue the letter to a third party (Pexarol).
- The bridge letter will include our standard disclaimer that the letter is not an opinion and does not extend the original report's testing.
- Typical turnaround is 3-5 business days after receipt of engagement confirmation; expedited service (1-2 business days) is available for a nominal fee.

We have prepared a draft bridge letter for coverage through 2026-04-15 and attached it as bridge-letter-20260412-brightstone.pdf. The draft includes standard language and a placeholder for the issuance date and partner signature. Please review and advise if Pexarol requires any alternate wording.

Next recommended steps:
1) Redwood to confirm requested coverage date (please confirm 2026-04-15 or "through date of issuance");
2) Redwood to execute the engagement confirmation (we can provide a short form);
3) Brightstone will finalize and sign the bridge letter and send PDF.

Regards,
Claire Jensen
Engagement Partner, Brightstone Audit
audits@brightstone-audit.com
Attachment: bridge-letter-20260412-brightstone.pdf (draft bridge letter stub)
